title: Game Scenario
description: Schema for validating game scenario entries used in persona-aligned LLM NPC behavior research with activation steering.

id.description: Unique scenario identifier in the format scn_{genre}_{number}.

genre.description: The game genre category for this scenario.

context.description: Korean-language description of the game situation the NPC encounters.

actions.description: Exactly five possible actions the NPC can take in this scenario.

id.description: Unique action identifier in the format act_{number}.

label.description: Short English label for the action (e.g., attack, negotiate, flee).

description.description: English description of the action for embedding and evaluation purposes.

persona_alignment.description: The persona type this action aligns with.
